_about: Public-domain Thomas Belsham (1750-1829), Unitarian minister of Essex Street Chapel, London, for the Word Hoard: A Review of Mr. Wilberforce's Treatise (1798), Elements of the Philosophy of the Mind (1801), A Summary View of the Evidence of the Christian Revelation (1809), A Calm Inquiry into the Scripture Doctrine concerning the Person of Christ (1817), A Plea for Infant Baptism (1817), Memoirs of Theophilus Lindsey (1820), The Epistles of Paul translated with an exposition (4 vols., 1822) and his Discourses, doctrinal and practical (1826). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 77 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
